name: Chicago
hook: The city of Al Capone, the Bulls and the Sears Tower.

facts.label: Al Capone
facts.statement: Al Capone ran Chicago's mob, was convicted of tax evasion in 1931, and ended up at Alcatraz.

facts.label: Carl Sandburg
facts.statement: Carl Sandburg, the poet of Chicago, won a 1919 Pulitzer for Cornhuskers and was Illinois poet laureate from 1962 to 1967.

facts.label: Michael Jordan
facts.statement: Michael Jordan won five straight NBA scoring titles with the Bulls and returned to them in March 1995.

facts.label: John Dillinger
facts.statement: John Dillinger was shot outside Chicago's Biograph Theater in 1934, two months after Bonnie and Clyde died.

facts.label: the Sears Tower
facts.statement: The Sears Tower, designed by Fazlur Khan and completed in 1974, stood as the tallest building in the U.S.

facts.label: Lake Michigan
facts.statement: The Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal, opened in 1900, diverted the city's sewage away from Lake Michigan.

facts.label: Chicago the musical
facts.statement: The musical Chicago premiered in 1975, is set partly in the Cook County Jail, and won the 2002 Best Picture Oscar.
